units.source_text: 古老的砖门把电车道和大学体育场相隔，面对着西边天空下的层层叠叠的比睿山。

en.t: An old brick gate separated the streetcar road from the university athletic field, facing the layered ridges of Mount Hiei beneath the western sky.

units.source_text: 一进砖门就是一条碎石路，一直通到主楼门前的停车处。

en.t: Just inside the brick gate, a gravel road led straight to the parking area in front of the main building.

units.source_text: 主楼是一座古老的沉郁的二层红砖房子。

en.t: The main building was an old, gloomy, two-story red-brick structure.

units.source_text: 正门的门楼顶上，屹立着青铜的城楼，说它是钟楼又看不见钟，说它是时钟台，又没有时钟。

en.t: On top of the gatehouse at the main entrance stood a bronze tower; if one called it a bell tower, no bell could be seen, and if one called it a clock tower, there was no clock.

units.source_text: 于是这座城楼在纤细的避雷针下，用它的空洞的方形窗口，把蔚蓝的天空裁剪了下来。

en.t: And so, beneath its slender lightning rod, the tower used its hollow square windows to cut out pieces of the deep blue sky.
